en: Sepia-toned vintage image showing a manor-style house with a long, low roof on a hill above a river or lake. Smaller rural buildings sit near the water and along a winding road that leads through gently rolling countryside with bare or sparsely leaved trees, suggesting early spring or late autumn. The edges of the card are worn and slightly torn, especially at the corners. In the lower right corner there is faint printed text, partly visible.
